home.title: Read Before Playing
home.notice1: This is a 2D side-scrolling single-player sandbox game, mainly available on Windows, MacOS and Linux, with text in ten languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Korean, Russian and Swedish. As rendering is based on WebGL, the hardware requirements are very low: ordinary office laptops, older computers and devices with integrated graphics can usually run it smoothly. Before downloading, you only need to confirm your platform, your preferred language and how you would like to control the game.
home.notice2: In terms of gameplay, it is an open-world sandbox with a high degree of freedom and no win condition; the overall experience is similar to a 2D side-scrolling version of Minecraft. You can gather, build, explore and survive, or simply wander around, reshape the world or set your own goals. There is no need to rush your progress, and certainly no ending you have to reach. As a single-player game, the pace is entirely up to you. We suggest getting familiar with the basic controls first — moving, breaking, placing and crafting — and then developing at your own pace.
home.notice3: This game is completely free and open source. Not only can you obtain it for free, there are also no microtransactions and no content locked behind payment; you may study, modify or join the community as long as you comply with the open-source licence. Because it is a single-player sandbox, saves and worlds are usually stored locally, so we recommend backing them up regularly and downloading and updating only from official or trusted channels. If you would like to report a problem, please send the details to 3685585221@qq.com.
